newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Senate holds extraordinary session to discuss government measure to allow Romanians to use their ID cards as well as voter's cards to cast their votes in November 3 general polls.
* Cabinet holds weekly briefing to discuss winter energy stocks.
* Supreme Court is able to rule on contestations against candidacies of parties or individuals in next month's parliamentary elections. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
